label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'config_utils.py' — a small config-access module, at least 100 lines long, with a module docstring and these terse-named functions, each documented: 'get_val(cfg, key)' returns a value; 'set_val(cfg, key, value)' sets one; 'del_val(cfg, key)' removes one; 'has_val(cfg, key)' returns membership; 'merge_val(a, b)' merges two dicts. Also write 'tests/test_config_utils.py' covering 'get_val' and 'set_val'.
